risk_assessment.recommendation: Change passwords immediately for affected accounts

breaches.name: LinkedIn
breaches.title: LinkedIn Security Incident
breaches.description: Major social network suffered breach exposing millions of user accounts including passwords in plain text.

breaches.name: MyFitnessPal
breaches.title: MyFitnessPal Data Breach
breaches.description: Fitness tracking application exposed user credentials and fitness data for approximately 150 million users.

suggestions: Create a new unique password for each account
Use 16+ characters with mixed case and symbols
Use a password manager (1Password, Bitwarden, KeePass)

within_24_hours: Check account activity for suspicious actions
within_1_week: Change passwords for other accounts using same password
Set up password manager if not already done
ongoing: Monitor HIBP for new breaches (daily via framework)

tips: These breaches are from past incidents - not current vulnerability
Criminals may have these credentials - change passwords immediately
Not your fault - these companies were compromised
Monitor this email for future breaches
